name: Strabimon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Hybrid] trait, or [Susanoomon] or [Koji Minamoto] among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [On Deletion] You may play 1 [Koji Minamoto] from your hand without paying its memory cost.
